blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Atty. Levito Baligod, legal counsel for the 18 “maleta boys,” said National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag is the one who needs to take a lie detector test. Baligod made this statement when asked about the NBI chief’s remark that the bureau also asked the “maleta boys”—who implicated various government officials, including President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. and former House Speaker Martin Romualdez, in a “cash delivery” scheme—to undergo lie detector tests when they appeared in March as part of the investigation into their testimonies.
